# Feature reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs/update_manual.py scaffold from docs/manual/registry.json; do not edit by hand -->

Every user-facing feature of EZ-YX-craft 0.2.0, grouped by module. Select a feature to open its section of the manual.

## The carving pipeline

The main window. A job moves through four steps — Stock, Design, Toolpaths, Output — and every design element is a feature on the timeline.

| Feature | What it does | Since |
|---|---|---|
| [The four steps](../pipeline/index.md#the-four-steps) | The step bar at the top of the main window walks a job from raw stock to G-code: ① Stock, ② Design, ③ Toolpaths, ④ Output. | 0.2.0 |
| [Stock setup](../pipeline/stock.md) | Decide what the machine cuts from: material, shape (rectangular board, round blank or rotary cylinder), size, where Z zero is (stock top or bed) and where XY zero sits on the stock. | 0.2.0 |
| [Feature timeline](../pipeline/timeline.md) | The left panel lists the stock and every feature in design order. | 0.2.0 |
| [Drawing tools](../pipeline/design.md#drawing-tools) | Basic 2D drawing in the Design step: rectangle, circle, ellipse, polygon, star, polyline and TrueType text. | 0.2.0 |
| [Editing, arranging & layers](../pipeline/design.md#editing-arranging--layers) | Offset, weld (union), subtract and intersect closed shapes; move, scale, rotate and mirror with exact numbers; align and distribute several shapes; centre on the stock; organise vectors on layers you can hide or lock. | 0.2.0 |
| [Snapping & measuring](../pipeline/design.md#snapping--measuring) | Snap the cursor to the grid, to shape corners and midpoints, and to the stock edges and centre. | 0.2.0 |
| [Carve tools](../pipeline/design.md#carve-tools) | Turn selected vectors into a feature with one click: Cut out, Inside cut, Pocket, V-carve, Engrave, Drill or On the line. | 0.2.0 |
| [Importing designs](../pipeline/design.md#importing-designs) | Bring in SVG/DXF vectors as 2D features and STL/OBJ meshes as 3D model features. | 0.2.0 |
| [Editing a feature again (merge)](../pipeline/timeline.md#editing-a-feature-again-merge) | Features that came from the Image Studio or the Solid Modeler remember their source. | 0.2.0 |
| [Conflict checks](../pipeline/timeline.md#conflict-checks) | The pipeline continuously checks for features that run off the stock, cut deeper than the stock is thick, overlap each other, lost their geometry, or whose bit is too big to cut anything, and for hand-made operations made for an older revision. | 0.2.0 |
| [Automatic toolpaths](../pipeline/toolpaths.md#automatic-toolpaths) | When you open ③ Toolpaths every feature already has the best roughing and finishing cycle for it: cut-outs get a roughing profile with allowance plus a finishing profile with tabs; pockets a large-bit clearing pass and a smaller-bit finish; V-carves a flat-floor clearance pass when the shape is wide; reliefs and 3D models a flat-end-mill roughing pass and a ball-nose finish. | 0.2.0 |
| [Choosing bits](../pipeline/toolpaths.md#choosing-bits) | Every feature's plan can use different bits for roughing and finishing, skip a pass, change the finishing allowance or turn tabs off. | 0.2.0 |
| [Hand-made operations (advanced)](../pipeline/toolpaths.md#hand-made-operations-advanced) | Add your own profile, pocket, V-carve, drill, engrave, laser or 3D operation with full control over feeds, depths and options. | 0.2.0 |
| [Toolpath preview](../pipeline/toolpaths.md#toolpath-preview) | Show roughing, finishing or both toolpaths in 2D or 3D, coloured by depth, and simulate material removal for exactly what is shown. | 0.2.0 |
| [Final rendered view](../pipeline/toolpaths.md#final-rendered-view) | The simulated result is rendered in your material (walnut, maple, oak, MDF, aluminium…) with machining advice such as scallop height, burn risk and overload warnings. | 0.2.0 |
| [G-code & job sheet](../pipeline/output.md#g-code--job-sheet) | Check the summary (time estimate, bits in order, tool changes, warnings), then save G-code for your machine's post-processor or a printable job sheet. | 0.2.0 |
| [Send to Machine Control](../pipeline/output.md#send-to-machine-control) | Hand the G-code straight to the Machine Control window, which opens with the job loaded and ready to run. | 0.2.0 |

## Image Studio

A separate window that turns photos, sketches and logos into 2D cuts, 2.5D reliefs, photo V-carves or 3D models and sends them to the pipeline.

| Feature | What it does | Since |
|---|---|---|
| [Image Studio](../image/index.md#open-the-studio-and-load-a-picture) | Its own window with an image viewer, live processing preview and the conversion settings. | 0.2.0 |
| [Trace outline → 2D cut](../image/index.md#trace-outline--2d-cut) | Logos and silhouettes become closed vectors for cut-outs, pockets or V-carving. | 0.2.0 |
| [Sketch → single line](../image/index.md#sketch--single-line) | Pen and pencil drawings become single centre-line paths for engraving. | 0.2.0 |
| [Image → 2.5D relief](../image/index.md#image--25d-relief) | Greyscale becomes height: bright = high (or invert), with gamma, smoothing, size and depth. | 0.2.0 |
| [Photo V-carve](../image/index.md#photo-v-carve) | Shaded photos become V-grooves whose depth follows the darkness, as lines, waves or circles. | 0.2.0 |
| [Image → 3D model](../image/index.md#image--3d-model) | A silhouette (transparent PNGs work best) is inflated into a 3D model that is carved top-down. | 0.2.0 |
| [Send to pipeline / update feature](../image/index.md#send-to-pipeline--update-feature) | Send creates a new feature in the pipeline, centred on the stock. | 0.2.0 |

## Solid Modeler

A separate parametric part modeller (sketches, constraints, features, parameters) whose parts are carved in the pipeline as 2.5D reliefs or 3D models.

| Feature | What it does | Since |
|---|---|---|
| [Solid Modeler](../solid/index.md#the-solid-modeler-window) | A SolidWorks-style part modeller in its own window: the FeatureManager tree on the left, a 3D view in the middle, the PropertyManager on the right and a CommandManager with Sketch, Features, Evaluate and Export tabs on top. | 0.2.0 |
| [Sketches & constraints](../solid/sketch.md#draw-and-constrain-a-sketch) | Draw lines, rectangles, circles, arcs and splines on the XY, XZ or YZ plane, then constrain them: coincident, horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, equal, concentric, midpoint, symmetric, fix, and driving dimensions (length, distance, radius, diameter, angle) that may use parameters. | 0.2.0 |
| [Extrude, revolve, sweep & loft](../solid/features.md#extrude-revolve-sweep--loft) | Extrude a sketch (blind, mid-plane or through all, with draft and rounded or chamfered cap edges), revolve it (full or partial), sweep a profile along a path, or loft between sections. | 0.2.0 |
| [Fillet, chamfer, shell & draft](../solid/features.md#fillet-chamfer-shell--draft) | Round or chamfer where a feature meets the body, fillet the whole part, hollow it with a shell (optionally open at the top, for enclosures) and add draft to extrusions. | 0.2.0 |
| [Hole wizard & threads](../solid/features.md#hole-wizard--threads) | Simple, drilled, counterbored, countersunk and tapped holes, and modelled external or internal threads. | 0.2.0 |
| [Patterns & mirror](../solid/features.md#patterns--mirror) | Linear, grid and circular patterns of a feature, and mirror about the YZ, XZ or XY plane. | 0.2.0 |
| [Split, combine & scale](../solid/features.md#split-combine--scale) | Split the part by a plane, combine it with another part (add, subtract, common) and scale it. | 0.2.0 |
| [Parameters & configurations](../solid/parameters.md#parameters-expressions-and-configurations) | Named parameters with unit-aware expressions (e.g. | 0.2.0 |
| [Mass properties & interference](../solid/evaluate.md#mass-properties--interference) | Volume, surface area, centre of mass, bounding box and mass for the chosen material, section area at a height, and the interference volume between two parts. | 0.2.0 |
| [Starter templates](../solid/index.md#starter-templates) | Ready-made parametric parts to learn from or adapt: enclosure, flange with bolt circle, knob, threaded rod, lofted vase. | 0.2.0 |
| [Export & send to pipeline](../solid/evaluate.md#export--send-to-pipeline) | Send the part to the pipeline as a 2.5D relief (top-down height field) or as a 3D model, update the feature made from it, export STL/OBJ, or a tetrahedral mesh (VTK/Gmsh) for analysis. | 0.2.0 |
| [SolidCraft bridge](../solid/index.md#solidcraft-bridge) | If the open-source SolidCraft CAD is installed, open the part's mesh in it for B-rep work (STEP, assemblies, sheet metal) and import its STL/OBJ exports back as a pipeline feature. | 0.2.0 |

## Machine Control

A separate window to connect to the CNC over USB, Wi-Fi or WebSocket, jog, zero, probe and run G-code from files or from the pipeline.

| Feature | What it does | Since |
|---|---|---|
| [Machine Control window](../machine/index.md#the-machine-control-window) | A separate window that never changes your design: connection bar, big position read-out, jog pad, job queue with a path preview, run controls, overrides and console. | 0.2.0 |
| [Connecting: USB, Wi-Fi, WebSocket, simulator](../machine/index.md#connecting-usb-wi-fi-websocket-simulator) | Choose USB serial (port + baud), Wi-Fi TCP/telnet, WebSocket, or the built-in simulator. | 0.2.0 |
| [Jogging, homing & zeroing](../machine/index.md#jogging-homing--zeroing) | Large jog buttons with step sizes and feed, home, unlock, and zero any axis. | 0.2.0 |
| [Z probe](../machine/index.md#z-probe) | Probe the stock top with a touch plate of known thickness. | 0.2.0 |
| [Running jobs](../machine/index.md#running-jobs) | Load G-code files or receive jobs from the pipeline, check the path preview and estimated time, then run, pause, resume or stop. | 0.2.0 |
| [Overrides & console](../machine/index.md#overrides--console) | Feed and spindle overrides while running, and a console for G-code and $ commands. | 0.2.0 |

## AI assistant

Claude, OpenAI or a local model that edits the project through the same commands as the GUI.

| Feature | What it does | Since |
|---|---|---|
| [AI assistant](../assistant.md#ask-the-assistant) | Ask in plain language — "make a 200×100 walnut sign that says Workshop" — and the assistant builds features, plans toolpaths and (only after you confirm) writes files or moves the machine. | 0.2.0 |
